name: MCP Server (local launch)
description: A stranger's MCP server extension that LAUNCHES a local stdio server process. The architecture test (rsj): the model (or catalogue) is authoring a LAUNCH, not a function — a strictly larger authority question than tool registration. On this placement there is no mechanism that bounds a spawned child, so admission must refuse it by name.

tools.name: mcp_list_tools
tools.description: List the tools the MCP server exposes (requires launching it).
tools.promptSnippet: mcp_list_tools launches the MCP server and lists its tools.
